50598-the-dark-frigate.title: The Dark Frigate
50598-the-dark-frigate.creator: Unknown
50598-the-dark-frigate.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Philip Marsham was bred to the sea as far back as the days when he was cutting his milk teeth, and he never thought he should leave it; but leave it he did, once and again, as I shall tell you.

arxiv-2010-11899.title: Magnetic properties and quench dynamics of two interacting ultracold molecules in a trap
arxiv-2010-11899.creator: Anna Dawid, Michał Tomza
arxiv-2010-11899.description: Abstract We theoretically investigate the magnetic properties and nonequilibrium dynamics of two interacting ultracold polar and paramagnetic molecules in a one-dimensional harmonic trap in external electric and magnetic fields. The molecules interact via a multichannel two-body contact potential, incorporating the short-range anisotropy of intermolecular interactions.

arxiv-2011-08683.title: Fisher Information of a Family of Generalized Normal Distributions
arxiv-2011-08683.creator: Precious Ugo Abara, Sandra Hirche
arxiv-2011-08683.description: Abstract In this brief note we compute the Fisher information of a family of generalized normal distributions. Fisher information is usually defined for regular distributions, i.e. continuously differentiable (log) density functions whose support does not depend on the family parameter θ \theta .

arxiv-2103-02371.title: Self-Checking Deep Neural Networks in Deployment
arxiv-2103-02371.creator: Yan Xiao 1 , Ivan Beschastnikh 2 , David S. Rosenblum 3 , Changsheng Sun 1 , Sebastian Elbaum 5 , Yun Lin 1 and Jin Song Dong 1
arxiv-2103-02371.description: Abstract The widespread adoption of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) in important domains raises questions about the trustworthiness of DNN outputs. Even a highly accurate DNN will make mistakes some of the time, and in settings like self-driving vehicles these mistakes must be quickly detected and properly dealt with in deployment .

arxiv-2103-15821.title: Generalized c c -almost periodic type functions in ℝ n {\mathbb{R}}^{n}
arxiv-2103-15821.creator: M. Kostić
arxiv-2103-15821.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by M. Kostić. In this paper, we analyze multi-dimensional quasi-asymptotically c c -almost periodic functions and their Stepanov generalizations as well as multi-dimensional Weyl c c -almost periodic type functions. We also analyze several important subclasses of the class of multi-dimensional quasi-asymptotically c c -almost periodic functions and reconsider the notion of semi- c c -periodicity in the multi-dimensional setting, working in the general framework of Lebesgue spaces with variable exponent.

arxiv-2107-10237.title: YITP-21-77 Counting tensor rank decompositions
arxiv-2107-10237.creator: Dennis Obster and Naoki Sasakura
arxiv-2107-10237.description: Abstract The tensor rank decomposition is a useful tool for the geometric interpretation of the tensors in the canonical tensor model (CTM) of quantum gravity. In order to understand the stability of this interpretation, it is important to be able to estimate how many tensor rank decompositions can approximate a given tensor.

arxiv-2108-06978.title: Benchmarking Machine Learning Algorithms for Adaptive Quantum Phase Estimation with Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum Sensors
arxiv-2108-06978.creator: N.F.C.Nelson Filipe Costa, Y.O.Yasser Omar, A.S.Aidar Sultanov, G.S.P.Gheorghe Sorin Paraoanu
arxiv-2108-06978.description: Abstract Quantum phase estimation is a paradigmatic problem in quantum sensing and metrology. Here we show that adaptive methods based on classical machine learning algorithms can be used to enhance the precision of quantum phase estimation when noisy non-entangled qubits are used as sensors.

arxiv-2307-03200.title: Transcribing Educational Videos Using Whisper A preliminary study on using AI for transcribing educational videos
arxiv-2307-03200.creator: Ashwin Rao
arxiv-2307-03200.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ashwin Rao. Videos are increasingly being used for e-learning, and transcripts are vital to enhance the learning experience. The costs and delays of generating transcripts can be alleviated by automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems. In this article, we quantify the transcripts generated by whisper for 25 educational videos and identify some open avenues of research when leveraging ASR for transcribing educational videos.

arxiv-2403-02600.title: TESTAM: A Time-Enhanced Spatio-Temporal Attention Model with Mixture of Experts
arxiv-2403-02600.creator: Hyunwook Lee & Sungahn Ko
arxiv-2403-02600.description: Abstract Accurate traffic forecasting is challenging due to the complex interdependencies of large road networks and abrupt speed changes caused by unexpected events. Recent work has focused on spatial modeling with adaptive graph embedding or graph attention but has paid less attention to the temporal characteristics and effectiveness of in-situ modeling.

arxiv-2409-00213.title: Steklov-Neumann spectral problem: asymptotic analysis and applications to diffusion-controlled reactions Thanks: Submitted to the editors DATE.
arxiv-2409-00213.creator: Denis S. Grebenkov
arxiv-2409-00213.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Denis S. Grebenkov. We consider the mixed Steklov-Neumann spectral problem for the modified Helmholtz equation in a bounded domain when the Steklov condition is imposed on a connected subset of the smooth boundary. In order to deduce the asymptotic behavior in the limit when the size of the subset goes to zero, we reformulate the original problem in terms of an integral operator whose kernel is the restriction of a suitable Green’s function (or pseudo-Green’s function) to the subset.

arxiv-2601-00440.title: The dynamics of cultural systems Chapter in Johan Lind and Anna Jon-And, eds. (in press): Cultural Evolution from Minimal Principles . Cambridge, United Kingdom: Cambridge University Press. This work was supported by the Marianne and Marcus Wallenberg Foundation (2021.0039).
arxiv-2601-00440.creator: Fredrik Jansson Department of Business and Mathematics, Mälardalen University, Västerås, Sweden Centre for Cultural Evolution, Department of Psychology, Stockholm University, Sweden Institute for Futures Studies, Stockholm, Sweden
arxiv-2601-00440.description: Abstract Culture is not just traits but a dynamic system of interdependent beliefs, practices and artefacts embedded in cognitive, social and material structures. Culture evolves as these entities interact, generating path dependence, attractor states and tension, with long-term stability punctuated by rapid systemic transformations.

arxiv-2603-01580.title: Markovian ODE-guided scoring can assess the quality of offline reasoning traces in language models
arxiv-2603-01580.creator: Arghodeep Nandi, Ojasva Saxena, Tanmoy Chakraborty

arxiv-2603-16221.creator: Advika Rajapakse

pmc-10522581.title: The immunome of mobilized peripheral blood stem cells is predictive of long-term outcomes and therapy-related myeloid neoplasms in patients with multiple myeloma undergoing autologous stem cell transplant
pmc-10522581.creator: Saurabh Zanwar, Eapen K Jacob, Carl Greiner, Kevin Pavelko, Michael Strausbauch, Emilie Anderson, Arini Arsana, Megan Weivoda, Mithun Vinod Shah, Taxiarchis Kourelis
pmc-10522581.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Upfront autologous stem cell transplant (ASCT) is the standard of care for newly diagnosed multiple myeloma (MM) patients. However, relapse is ubiquitous and therapy-related myeloid neoplasms (t-MN) post-ASCT are commonly associated with poor outcomes. We hypothesized that the enrichment of abnormal myeloid progenitors and immune effector cells (IEC) in the peripheral blood stem cells (PBSCs) is associated with a higher risk of relapse and/or development of t-MN.

pmc-11423452.title: Novel COL5A1 variants and associated disease phenotypes in dogs with classical Ehlers‐Danlos syndrome
pmc-11423452.creator: Garrett Bullock, Jared A. Jaffey, Leah A. Cohn, Erika Sox, Eric T. Hostnik, Kyle D. Hutcheson, Erin Matero, Karen S. Hoffmann, Gary S. Johnson, Martin L. Katz
pmc-11423452.description: BackgroundHuman patients with Ehlers‐Danlos syndrome (EDS) are categorized into subtypes based on causative genetic variants and phenotypes. The classical form of EDS, primarily caused by variants in COL5A1 or COL5A2, is a very common subtype in people but is poorly characterized in dogs.

pmc-11454186.title: 8572 A 30% Maternal Caloric Restriction Alters Expression of Musashi Targets in the Neonatal and Adult Pituitary Proteomes of FVB Mice
pmc-11454186.creator: Tiffany K Miles, Victoria G Ortega, Kya D Carroll, Angela Katherine Odle, Stephanie D Byrum, Allen J Gies, Alex N Lagasse, Anessa C Haney, Melanie C MacNicol, Angus M MacNicol, Gwen V Childs
pmc-11454186.description: Disclosure: T.K. Miles: None. V.G. Ortega: None. K.D. Carroll: None. A.K. Odle: None. S.D. Byrum: None. A.J. Gies: None. A.N. Lagasse: None. A.C. Haney: None. M.C. MacNicol: None. A.M. MacNicol: None. G.V. Childs: None.Leptin is involved in pituitary development and function and regulates the expression of Musashi (MSI), a translational regulator that inhibits Pou1f1 expression.

pmc-11491097.title: Associations Between Psychological Stress and the Risk of First Onset of Major Depression Disorder: Results from a Longitudinal Study in 6,985 Chinese First-Year Students
pmc-11491097.creator: Fengting Wang, Limin Rong, Linlin Luo, Fuqin Mu, Liju Qian, Yandan Qian, Xinyao Zhang, Yuying Lang, Weijia Wang, Yan Liu, Ying Zhang, Jianli Wang
pmc-11491097.description: BackgroundYouth and young adults have a high prevalence of major depressive disorder (MDD). Limited longitudinal research has explored the relationship between different dimensions of psychological stress and MDD. This study aimed to estimate the effect of psychological stress on the risk of first onset MDD in a sample of Chinese freshmen.

pmc-11678072.title: Dental Considerations in Children with Inherited Bleeding Disorders and Inhibitors: A Systematic Review
pmc-11678072.creator: Sanja Vujkov, Branislav Bajkin, Duška Blagojević, Isidora Nešković, Jelena Komšić, Ana Tadić, Bojan Petrović
pmc-11678072.description: Background/Objectives: This systematic review evaluates the effectiveness of various hematological treatment protocols and local hemostatic measures in preventing oral bleeding and other complications during and after dental treatments in children with inherited bleeding disorders and inhibitors. Methods: This study was registered in the PROSPERO database.

pmc-12474446.title: Metabolic Regulation of Influenza Vaccine Responses in Racially Diverse Hispanics
pmc-12474446.creator: Daniela Frasca, Maria Romero, Suresh Pallikkuth
pmc-12474446.description: Background: Racial and ethnic differences in vaccine responses, particularly within Hispanic populations, remain underexplored. Disparities in immune function may be influenced by metabolic and inflammatory mechanisms. Methods: The current study investigated humoral immune responses to influenza vaccination in a diverse cohort of Hispanic individuals from South Florida, encompassing both White and Black Hispanics.

pmc-12513275.title: Bridging human and animal personality: A behavioral test to assess reward sensitivity
pmc-12513275.creator: Susana C.M. Ferreira, Fabiana De Angelis, Sarah Ambruosi, Giulia Ferroni, Matteo Chincarini, Charlotte Goursot
pmc-12513275.description: SummaryAccounting for individual differences in depression or resilience is crucial to ensure individualized well-being. Differences in tendencies to approach rewards and avoid threats reflect personality and help to understand what animals want and like. At the neural level, these tendencies involve the behavioral activation system (BAS) and the behavioral inhibition system (BIS).

pmc-12623192.title: Pediatric eye movement-based perimetry: progress, pitfalls, and prospects
pmc-12623192.creator: Anna Boethun, Sarah Linea von Holstein, René Mathiasen, Miriam Kolko, Frans W. Cornelissen, Jeroen Goossens, Barbara Johanne Thomas Nordhjem
pmc-12623192.description: IntroductionEye movement-based perimetry (EMP) is a promising, non-invasive approach for visual field assessment, particularly in pediatric populations where standard automated perimetry often fails. However, completion rates in prior pediatric EMP studies have ranged from 41 to 81%, and reasons for unsuccessful testing are seldom reported.

pmc-12663660.title: Extensor tenosynovitis and subcutaneous abscess caused by hypervirulent Klebsiella pneumoniae
pmc-12663660.creator: Takahiro Fukushima, Takaaki Kobayashi, Poorani Sekar, Shinichi Sotome, Tadashi Eguchi, Akihito Yoshida
pmc-12663660.description: We report a rare case of invasive Klebsiella pneumoniae infection in a previously healthy 52-year-old Japanese man who presented with extensor tenosynovitis associated with subcutaneous abscess of the right hand, in the setting of concomitant liver and prostatic abscesses. Cultures from blood, liver abscess aspirate, synovial fluid and aspirate from the subcutaneous tissue of the hand all grew K. pneumoniae.

pmc-12678181.title: Profiling endothelial function, oxidative stress and inflammatory biomarkers in individuals with various cardiovascular risk factors: the African-PREDICT study
pmc-12678181.creator: Adriaan Jacobs, Ruan Kruger, Wayne Smith, Maserame C Mokhaneli, Catharina M C Mels
pmc-12678181.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Cardiovascular risk factors are known to contribute to cardiovascular disease (CVD) development by inducing endothelial activation, increasing oxidative stress and pro-inflammation. The early interaction between these pathways and individual cardiovascular (CV) risk factors is poorly understood. We profiled a range of circulating endothelial function, oxidative stress and inflammatory biomarkers and explored their associations with individual CV risk factors in young (20–30 years, n = 1196) adults without self-reported chronic conditions or medication use.

pmc-13116361.title: Polyrotaxane‐Assembled Semi‐Interpenetrating Polymer Electrolytes Enabling High‐Voltage Lithium Metal Batteries
pmc-13116361.creator: Tianyi Wang, Yue Ma, Jiacheng Liu, Zhaofan He, Jin Liang, Kailiang Ren, Jie Kong
pmc-13116361.description: Polyether‐based solid polymer electrolytes suffer from low ionic conductivity at room temperature, poor oxidative stability at high voltages, and susceptibility to dendrite growth, all of which hinder their application in high‐energy‐density lithium batteries. Herein, we report a polyrotaxane‐assembled supramolecular semi‐interpenetrating network electrolyte (SSNE), synthesized through in situ polymerization of polyrotaxane with crosslinked polydioxolane (PDOL).

pmc-13208482.title: Ganoderma lucidum as a Functional Bioactive Candidate for Glycemic Regulation: Mechanisms, Preclinical Evidence, and Clinical Translation
pmc-13208482.creator: Bogdan Florea, Doru Morar, Corina Marina Kracunovic, Simina Velescu, Vlad Iorgoni, Paula Nistor, Janos Degi, Ionica Iancu, Maria-Larisa Ardelean (Rusu), Romeo Teodor Cristina, Alexandra Pocinoc, Eugenia Dumitrescu
pmc-13208482.description: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) is a major global health challenge that has intensified interest in multi-target nutraceuticals with potential adjunctive benefits. Ganoderma lucidum (Lingzhi/Reishi) is a medicinal mushroom traditionally used in East Asia and is increasingly investigated for its role in glycemic regulation and metabolic disturbances.

pmc-13325435.title: Towards globally equitable bioinformatics adoption
pmc-13325435.creator: Paulyna Magaña, Piraveen Gopalasingam, Jennifer R. Fleming, Oleg Kovalevskiy, Augustin Žídek, ThankGod Echezona Ebenezer, Agata Laydon, Roz Onions, Eva Akurut, Syed Muktadir Al Sium, Yalbi Itzel Balderas-Martínez, Sanjana Fatema Chowdhury, Saikat Chowdhury, Sylvia Christie, Govinda Rao Dabburu, Fato
pmc-13325435.description: Advances in artificial intelligence (AI)-driven bioinformatics promise democratized discovery, yet major inequities persist. Equitable adoption of bioinformatics tools will require sustained investment in infrastructure, training, institutions, and global communities, not just access. Advances in bioinformatics and artificial intelligence (AI) have reshaped the life sciences, enabling large-scale data analysis, predictive modeling, and integrative approaches across disciplines [1,2].

pmc-13340926.title: Investigation and computational prediction of gating pore currents in NaV1.2 mutations across clinical phenotypes
pmc-13340926.creator: Ahmed Eltokhi, Eslam Elhanafy, Jing Li, Tamer M Gamal El-Din
pmc-13340926.description: Voltage sensor domains (VSDs) are integral and common regions within voltage-gated ion channels that play a crucial role in cellular signaling and excitability. Each VSD comprises four transmembrane segments (S1–S4) per domain. The transmembrane segment S4 contains positively charged amino acid residues at every third position, which serve as the channel's gating charges.

pmc-13454799.title: Correction: Fetal bladder rupture in posterior urethral valves: a clinically relevant complication or a protective pop-off mechanism
pmc-13454799.creator: Karolina Krzywiecka, Natalia Lekston, Zofia Sieroń, Hanna Kubik, Agnieszka Wiernik, Grzegorz Kudela

pmc-13508982.title: Sexual Dimorphism in Swim Bladder Texture, Composition, and Muscle Nutrient Profile of Commercial-Sized Black-Spotted Croaker (Protonibea diacanthus)
pmc-13508982.creator: Cheng Peng, Jiahui Chen, Huayi Xue, Ningwen Zhang, Sen Li, Yaorong Wang, Yong Zhang, Shijia Hu
pmc-13508982.description: Simple SummaryThe black-spotted croaker is a large marine fish highly valued for its swim bladder. This gas-filled organ, dried and sold as “fish maw”, is a luxury food in Asian markets. Male fish maw often sells at much higher prices than female fish maw, but the reasons for this preference have remained unclear.

pmc-13569837.title: Fourier-based chemometric resolution of the FOLFOX regimen through digital filtering with poly-metric sustainability assessment
pmc-13569837.creator: Hadir M Maher, Salma Mahmoud Mohamed, Ekram M Hassan, Amira Fawzy El-Yazbi
pmc-13569837.description: The FOLFOX regimen, comprising oxaliplatin (OXA), 5-fluorouracil (5-FU), and leucovorin (LU), is a standard first-line protocol for colorectal cancer therapy. Given its clinical centrality, developing rapid and high-throughput analytical tools for simultaneous determination of its components is essential. However, severe spectral overlap among the three drugs severely complicates their direct spectrophotometric analysis.

pmc-13609485.title: Incidence of Malignant Oral Cavity Tumors in the Republic of Serbia: Trend Analysis (1999–2020) and Projections to 2040
pmc-13609485.creator: Vojkan Lazić, Vladimir Videnović, Andrija Ćosić, Milan Miladinović, Marko Matvijenko, Aleksandar Šubarić, Aleksandra Ilić, Vladimir Matvijenko, Dejan Perić, Goran Videnović
pmc-13609485.description: Background and Objectives: Malignant tumors of the oral cavity are an important and growing component of the global cancer burden, with well-documented sex disparities in incidence. This study aimed to characterize temporal trends in the incidence of these tumors in the Republic of Serbia between 1999 and 2020, overall and by sex, and to forecast incidence through 2040.

pmc-13643432.title: Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement in Patients With Interstitial Lung Disease
pmc-13643432.creator: Rachel Schenkel, Andreas Polycarpou, David Perlman, Sara Shumway
pmc-13643432.description: BackgroundPatients with interstitial lung disease (ILD) are at higher risk of complications with cardiac surgery than the general population, leading to interest in transcatheter technologies such as transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) as an alternative to surgery for this patient population. However, outcomes of TAVR in patients with ILD remain under assessment.
